items.title: My Personal Portfolio – Version 3
items.shortDescription: A multi-page personal portfolio built with React to showcase my professional background, skills, and projects, featuring Arabic and English support, light and dark themes, and an advanced contact form.
items.overview: The third and current version of my personal portfolio, created to present my professional identity and showcase my skills and projects to recruiters and potential clients. The website uses React to build reusable components and enables navigation between pages without full page reloads. It supports Arabic and English, as well as light and dark themes. It includes pages for my professional profile, projects, project details, and contact information, along with a contact form that supports file attachments, Cloudflare Turnstile security verification, and Supabase integration. I planned the website structure and requirements and developed the project with the assistance of AI tools to improve the code, design, and user experience, while maintaining a consistent visual identity and responsiveness across devices.
features: A multi-page website presenting my professional background, skills, projects, and project details.
A homepage featuring an introduction, services, featured projects, and calls to action.
Arabic and English language support with RTL and LTR layouts.
Light and dark theme switching with consistent colors and styling.
Responsive design for phones, tablets, and desktop computers.
Seamless navigation using React Router without full page reloads.
Dedicated project detail pages displaying descriptions, features, technologies, and links.
A contact form with input validation, file attachments, Supabase integration, and Cloudflare Turnstile verification.
items.responsibilitiesIntro: I planned the portfolio website, defined its goals, page structure, components, and content, and used ChatGPT to assist with code generation, interface development, and improvements. I focused on reviewing the content, final results, user experience, and visual consistency.
responsibilities: Defined the website concept, objectives, and target audience of recruiters and potential clients.

Managed project files using Git and GitHub and deployed the website through GitHub Pages.

items.title: Freelancer Hub
items.shortDescription: A freelance marketplace connecting freelancers with project owners, offering account, project, and professional profile management, along with an administrative dashboard and role-based permissions.
items.overview: A team graduation project completed as part of the Full-Stack Web Development diploma at the Applied College, Taibah University. The platform aims to connect freelancers with project owners. It supports three account types—freelancer, project owner, and administrator—with different permissions for managing profiles, projects, searching, and filtering. An administrative dashboard provides statistics and tools to manage users, projects, categories, and skills, review project publication requests, and view transaction records. The project was developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL. Some features are planned for future completion, particularly the bidding system.

Manage freelancer professional profiles and display skills, experience, and portfolio samples.

features.title: Project Management and Search

features.title: Transaction Records

items.title: WordPress Management Dashboard with REST API
items.shortDescription: A dashboard for managing WordPress users and posts through the REST API, supporting viewing, creating, editing, and deleting records, with authentication using application passwords.
items.overview: A team academic project for the Content Management Systems course at Taibah University. The project involved building an external dashboard to manage WordPress users and posts through the REST API. The dashboard connects to a WordPress site using credentials and an application password, performs CRUD operations, manages user roles and post statuses, and displays success and error messages. Functionality was developed using JavaScript and the Fetch API, while interfaces were styled with HTML and Tailwind CSS. The team also prepared academic documentation and a presentation and received full marks.
features: Connect to a WordPress site and validate credentials using Application Passwords.
A dashboard with separate sections for managing users and posts.
View, create, edit, and delete users, with role management and filtering.
View, create, edit, and delete posts, with filtering by publication status.
Perform CRUD operations through the WordPress REST API using the Fetch API.
Check connection status, display success and error messages, and redirect when connection details are missing.
items.responsibilitiesIntro: I worked in a five-member team and took a major role in programming the functionality and integrating the WordPress REST API. I also prepared and formatted the academic documentation and presentation in collaboration with the team.

items.title: E-Commerce Admin Dashboard
items.shortDescription: A multi-page e-commerce administration dashboard featuring sales statistics and product and user management interfaces, developed as part of a Hsoub Academy training project.
items.overview: A training project focused on building the front-end interface of an e-commerce admin dashboard, which I implemented through hands-on practice alongside a Hsoub Academy instructor. The project includes product and user listing pages, forms for adding new items, and a main dashboard with sales statistics and charts built with Chart.js. The interfaces use reusable Handlebars components, Sass styles organized according to BEM and ITCSS, and Vite for development and builds, with responsive layouts for different devices.

items.title: Notes App with React
items.developmentArea: Web Application Development with React and JavaScript
items.shortDescription: A React notes management app that lets users create, view, edit, and delete notes, storing data locally with Local Storage without requiring a database.
items.overview: A training project completed as part of the React.js Fundamentals section of Hsoub Academy’s JavaScript Application Development course, through hands-on practice with the instructor from project setup to completion. The app allows users to create, view, edit, and delete notes, and stores their data on the user’s device with Local Storage so it persists after refreshing the page, without an external database. The project helped me understand React fundamentals, components, hooks, and state management, and provided knowledge I later applied when developing my React portfolio.
features: Create new notes with a title and text content.
Display a list of notes and select a note to view its contents.
Edit note titles and contents and save changes.
Delete notes from the list.
Store notes locally with Local Storage without an external database.
Restore saved notes after reloading the page.
Validate note titles and contents before saving or updating.
Display alerts when required fields are incomplete.
Organize the application interface into separate React components.
items.responsibilitiesIntro: I implemented the project through hands-on practice with a Hsoub Academy instructor as part of the React.js Fundamentals section, building the app step by step to gain experience with interactive React applications and data management.
responsibilities: Set up the project and followed its development stages through hands-on practice with the instructor using React.
